lots.title: Inspection & Maintenance of Indoor Gymnasium, Fitness & Sport Equipment and Outdoor Schools Play & Sport Equipment
lots.description: Synthetic single-scope lot representing the framework's undivided service scope. This document (107_26 Form of Contract and Call-Off Terms template) is the template used when ESPO-framework Customers (Contracting Authorities) place call-off contracts under Framework Agreement reference 107_26. The framework scope recited in this document covers inspection & maintenance of (a) indoor gymnasium, fitness & sport equipment and (b) outdoor schools play & sport equipment. The document itself does not subdivide the scope into lots, nor does it itemise goods, technical standards, quality standards, service levels or CPV codes — those are deferred to the Master Contract Schedule (populated per call-off), Framework Schedule 1, and the Framework Schedule 2 charging structure.
requirements: Supplier to deliver the Goods and/or Services in accordance with the Master Contract Schedule and any other Contract Document (per clause 6.3.4).
Goods to be free from defects in design and workmanship and fit for ordinary purpose and any particular purpose notified to the Supplier (clause 6.3.5.1).
Supplier to maintain business continuity arrangements throughout the Contract Period to minimise disruption to delivery (clause 8.1 / section 8).
Supplier to meet or exceed Service Levels; Critical Service Failure triggers a Customer termination right (clause 11.1, Schedule 1 Part A).
Supplier to provide Management Information in the form and periodicity specified in the Master Contract Schedule (clause 9.2).
Supplier to comply with Data Protection Legislation in the role (Controller / Joint Controllers / Independent Controllers) set out in section 9 of the Master Contract Schedule.

evaluation_criteria.summary: Service Credits are calculated as (100% − % of Service Level achieved) × Contract Charges and deducted from the next invoice, measured across bands 60-70% / 71-90% / 91-95% / 96-100%. Service Levels themselves are drafted at call-off time and populated into the Appendix to Part A of Schedule 1.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: SERVICE LEVELS AND SERVICE CREDITS | Service Level | Level achieved | 60-70% | 71-90% | 91-95% | 96-100%

evaluation_criteria.summary: A delay in servicing demand in excess of 24 consecutive hours during Normal Business Hours/Working Days more than once in any consecutive three (3) Month period, or more than three times in any consecutive twelve (12) Month period. Alternate formulation: loss of two (2) or more consecutive hours during Normal Business Hours accumulated beyond 24 such hours in any three (3) Months or 48 hours in any twelve (12) Months.
evaluation_criteria.weighting_text: Triggers Customer termination right under clause 9.1 / 19.3.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: Critical Service Failure shall mean a delay in servicing the demand … in excess of 24 consecutive hours during [Normal Business Hours/Working Days] more than once in any consecutive [three (3) Month period]

warnings.message: Document is tagged document_role='technical_specification' but its actual structure is a Form of Contract / Call-Off Terms legal template for Framework 107_26. It does not contain a technical specification, lot subdivision, or statement-of-requirements content. Strong candidate for role reclassification to 'form_of_contract' or 'call_off_terms'.

Master Contract Schedule fields for Goods required, Services and Deliverables required, Performance/Delivery Location, Quality Standards, Technical Standards, Supplier Solution, Key Personnel, Monitoring, Management Information, Customer's Responsibilities, Contract Charges, and Commercially Sensitive Information are all unfilled placeholders of the form '[     ]' or '[insert …]' pending per-call-off completion. No concrete technical standard, product, or quantity can be extracted from this document.

Document does not subdivide the framework into multiple lots. A single synthetic lot has been emitted representing the undivided framework scope (inspection & maintenance of indoor gym/fitness/sport equipment AND outdoor schools play/sport equipment).
No CPV codes are cited in the call-off terms template. CPV classification must be sourced from the Tender Notice (2026/S 000-002119) or Framework Agreement Schedule 1, not from this document.

Technical Standards field in the Master Contract Schedule is an unfilled placeholder. Contract text notes that 'Details of technical standards can be found in clause 13 of the Framework Agreement' — that document is not provided as part of this extraction, and clause 13 of the call-off terms (NOT USED) is empty.

No concrete product requirements are extractable. Services described are abstract (inspection & maintenance services) rather than procurable goods, and placeholders dominate the Goods Required and Services and Deliverables Required fields.
